# Merak
A somewhat hospitable, sandy planet with no water and no signs of life.
Geological samples show high concentrations of neodymium under the sand. This causes anomalies in the magnetosphere, leading to beautiful views during solar flares.
Permanent settlements were deemed impossible due to constant high-magnitude earthquakes.
## Since the Collapse
The quakes eased after [textlink="the Collapse" link="WFLoreCollapse"], and Merak turned out to be less dead than the surveys said. Dune seas, red badlands, cactus fields and cracked gravel flats cover the surface.
Desert tarantulas and cobras hunt the badlands. Sand maws lie under the dunes and drag anything that walks over them into an acid belly. Reaver APCs patrol its roads.
